filing_office: Secretary of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, Corporations Division
filing_fee_notes: Base formation and annual-report filing fees are each 500; electronic payment surcharges were not confirmed.
registered_agent_rules: Identify an agent for service of process and the agent's business address. Include the agent's consent on the certificate or an attachment.
annual_report_due: On or before the anniversary date of filing the original Certificate of Organization each year.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Organization and obtain the agent's consent. File an annual report by the filing anniversary.
common_mistake: Budgeting for formation but overlooking the separate annual-report fee.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Base state fees recorded. Formation processing time, expedite options, applicable franchise/corporate-excise treatment, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
